steps.observed: status: configuration /Users/kayden/Library/LaunchAgents/com.kayden.workbench-dashboard.plist (installed); launchd loaded, state running, pid 78048; http 127.0.0.1:4720 answers (HTTP 200); followed by owner-action instructions (install/print > plist/bootstrap/kickstart/bootout/inspect). print: a plist with Label com.kayden.workbench-dashboard, ProgramArguments /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.3.0/bin/node <copy>/tools/grill-board.mjs serve --path <copy> --port 4720, RunAtLoad, KeepAlive, logs under <copy>/workbench/grill-board/. steps.notes: D4: pid 78048 is the owner's live board (/Users/kayden/LLM_Workbench, port 4646) under the same default label, while the probe answered for the demo server on 4720. status reports both together without comparing the installed plist's path/port to the requested --path/--port, so it reads as if the service serves 4720. defects.title: Unsaved comment/change-request text is lost when returning to the question by its #GB-#### link (browser Back from the Wiki, or a search result)
defects.reproduction: Open #GB-0034; type text in 'Comment or change request' (do not send); click 'DDRs · The Workbench aligns...' (Wiki reader); press browser Back -> document.getElementById('comment-GB-0034').value === ''. Same via top search 'recursive delivery' -> click the GB-0034 result. Returning with the Grilling Board section tab (#section=grilling) keeps it.
defects.expected: README: back/forward and section tabs 'preserve the question DOM, saved notes, queued saves and unsaved notes'.
defects.actual: routePage() for a #GB-#### hash calls render(), which rebuilds the card; the comment textarea is not kept in state.edits (only the answer note is), so its text is discarded. Reproduced twice.

defects.title: Workflow action replay identity depends on JSON key order
defects.reproduction: POST /api/promotions {ids:['GB-0034'],revisions:{'GB-0034':7},actionId:'17e93b0f-...',expectedRevision:0} -> 200 idempotent:true; POST the same fields ordered {actionId,expectedRevision,ids,revisions} -> 409 action-id-conflict.
defects.expected: A retry of the same action and payload is recognized as the same action.
defects.actual: tools/dashboard-workflow.mjs start() hashes JSON.stringify({operation,payload}) without canonical key order. The served page always sends one order so the page is unaffected; a CLI or other client retry could be refused. Fails closed (no duplicate, no loss).

defects.title: dashboard-service status conflates the installed login service with whatever answers on the requested port
defects.reproduction: With the owner's service installed (label com.kayden.workbench-dashboard, /Users/kayden/LLM_Workbench, port 4646, pid 78048) run node tools/dashboard-service.mjs status --path <copy> --port 4720 while a demo server listens on 4720.
defects.expected: Status distinguishes the installed service's own target (path, port) from the requested one, or warns when they differ; install guidance warns before replacing an existing plist with that label.
defects.actual: Prints 'launchd loaded, state running, pid 78048' and 'http 127.0.0.1:4720 answers (HTTP 200)' as one healthy service; instructions offer 'print ... > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.kayden.workbench-dashboard.plist' for the copy, which would replace the owner's live configuration.

defects.title: print pins a versioned Homebrew Cellar node path
defects.expected: A stable node path (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/node, as in the owner's installed plist) or a note about it.
defects.actual: ProgramArguments[0] and PATH use /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.3.0/bin; after a node upgrade the KeepAlive service would fail to start.

observations.text: After re-confirming a revised question, the 'This question changed after you answered (now revision N; you answered revision N-1)' notice remains on the open card until reload, next to 'This is the current revision.'
Opening a question by clicking its list row does not update the address hash (stays on the previously opened #GB-####), so a reload reopens the previous question.

When a Change request blocks promotion, the disabled-button hint is the generic 'Only a card the workflow reports as confirmed can be promoted.'; the server's specific code change-awaiting-revision is not surfaced on the card.

Real confirm-ddr packages (e.g. GB-0034, GB-0047) still word their Recommended answer / What would change in the retired vocabulary ('Use Correct ...', 'Decline: deprecate ...') while the buttons are Confirm / Rework wording / Change the why / Change; GB-0034's 'Consequences and tradeoffs' shows the same paragraph twice. Content, not code.
grill-board.mjs USAGE string omits the working 'handoffs' and 'disposition --file' commands; README documents 'handoffs' only in passing and does not show a disposition invocation.
Ending a round re-renders the Grilling Board list and closes the open question view.
